name: Fiesta style
notes: Hector 10-28: 275 the whole time. Ribs on the same marks as rápido (185 point of interest, 203). Chicken: at 155 wrap in tin foil with butter, straight into a cooler, rest 30 minutes. Works for chicken alone too. Cook done when everything is off: the pit drops to 150 for the rest and the hold; the chicken in the cooler keeps its own 30 minutes.

pit.name: Fiesta
pit.tell: Fiesta style: pit at 275 the whole time.

ribs.name: Point of interest
ribs.tell: Ribs {ribs}°F, the point of interest: check the bark. Ready: tin foil with butter and BBQ or vinegar sauce, back on until 203. Not yet: keep going.

ribs.name: Done
ribs.tell: Ribs {ribs}°F: done. Take them off to rest; tap Cook done when everything's off (the pit drops to 150 for the hold).

chicken.name: Cooler
chicken.tell: Chicken {chicken}°F: wrap it in tin foil with butter and straight into the cooler. The 30-minute rest starts now.
